## Pull request overview

This PR updates `@object-ui/types` (and related docs/tests) to align with `@objectstack/spec` v2.0.1 by re-exporting additional spec namespaces/utilities, switching locally-defined protocol types to spec-canonical imports, and refreshing stale v0.x spec references across packages.

**Changes:**
- Re-export additional ObjectStack spec namespaces plus protocol utilities (`defineStack`, `definePlugin`, capabilities schemas/types) from `@object-ui/types`.
- Replace several locally defined protocol types (ObjectQL + theme sub-types) with `import type` re-exports from `@objectstack/spec/ui`.
- Update JSDoc/version references and adjust tests to cover the new exports.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 17 out of 17 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/zod/theme.zod.ts | JSDoc alignment wording updates; introduces/relocates `ThemeModeSchema` comment block. |

| packages/types/src/ui-action.ts | Updates spec version refs and reorganizes comments/types for action parameter field types. |
| packages/types/src/theme.ts | Replaces local theme sub-types with spec type re-exports; documents `Theme.mode` optionality vs spec inferred type. |
| packages/types/src/objectql.ts | Replaces local ObjectQL protocol types with spec type re-exports; updates config type definitions/docs. |

| packages/core/src/validation/__tests__/object-validation-engine.test.ts | Updates spec version references in documentation/comments. |
| packages/core/src/query/query-ast.ts | Updates spec version references in documentation/comments. |

The comment says these action sub-types are “imported from @objectstack/spec/ui”, but the file does not import anything from the spec and instead defines ActionLocation/ActionComponent/ActionType locally. Please either actually re-export/import these canonical types from the spec, or change the comment to reflect that these are local mirror types to avoid misleading consumers.

Re-exporting ObjectStackSchema/ObjectStackDefinitionSchema/etc from @objectstack/spec will expose Zod v3 schema instances through @object-ui/types, while this package depends on Zod v4. This creates a mixed-Zod public API (and likely ships both Zod versions) and can break consumers who expect v4 helpers/types to work with the exported schemas. Prefer keeping these as type-only re-exports, or provide mirrored Zod v4 schemas under @object-ui/types/zod instead of re-exporting the v3 runtime schemas.

KanbanConfig/CalendarConfig/GanttConfig are described as “Canonical definition from @objectstack/spec/ui”, but they are still defined locally in this file. If the spec provides canonical types for these configs, import/re-export them like the other spec-canonical types; otherwise, update the comment to indicate these are local mirror types so the source of truth is clear.
